items.title: RoleFlow: Self-Evolving Multi-Role Agentic Collaboration via Structural Adaptation
items.title_zh: RoleFlow：通过结构自适应实现自演化多角色智能体协作
items.summary: RoleFlow refines multi-agent collaboration structures through feedback-driven atomic edits and on-demand role synthesis, trained with Single-Edit Counterfactual Policy Optimization that credits each structural edit against its no-edit counterpart at the same chain state. Across seven benchmarks it surpasses the strongest competitor by 4.7 points on average and leads three multi-hop QA benchmarks by 3.2-7.5 F1 points.

items.title: Why Bother Me Again? Benchmarking Personal Agent Memory for Interaction Preferences
items.title_zh: 为什么又来烦我？面向交互偏好的个人智能体记忆基准
items.summary: MemPABench is an interactive environment for on-policy evaluation of personal-agent memory, with four simulated users holding 14 preferences across 99 sessions over four months and five event-driven preference changes per user. Evaluating four memory systems on four LLM backbones, the authors find that retrieval-based memory does not outperform No Memory on preference selection, while file-based memory improves accuracy but applies preferences beyond relevant contexts.

items.title: Graphify-Labs/graphify
items.title_zh: Graphify-Labs/graphify — 把代码库变成可查询知识图谱
items.summary: Graphify turns a codebase, including docs, SQL schemas, configs and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph via local deterministic AST parsing, with every edge explained and no vector store. It ships as a skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Gemini CLI.

items.title: Astro2Method: Benchmarking LLMs on Machine Learning Method Selection in Astronomy
items.title_zh: Astro2Method：在天文学机器学习方法选择上评测 LLM
items.summary: Astro2Method benchmarks 500 expert-reviewed binary questions drawn from 346 astronomy papers; five LLMs reach 87.50-92.55% accuracy on Easy questions but only 58.87-64.52% on Hard ones. Neither retrieval-augmented generation nor most reasoning or retrieval agents improve results consistently, while supplying the source paper's pipeline description with method names masked helps.

items.title: SWE-VERIFIER: Selective Verification for Cost-Efficient Coding Agents
items.title_zh: SWE-VERIFIER：面向高性价比编码智能体的选择性验证
items.summary: SWE-Verifier is a lightweight model trained from Qwen3.5-4B that scores a coding agent's proposed action to decide when candidate sampling is needed, then ranks the resulting actions before execution. It raises MiniMax-M2.7 resolution from 75.47% to 77.20% at 1.09x cost, generalizes to DeepSeek-V4-Flash without training on its actions, and verifies fewer than 4% of steps.

items.title: Before the Ticket: Grounding HPC User Support in Documentation and Resolved Tickets with an Agentic LLM Assistant
items.title_zh: 工单之前：基于文档与已解决工单的 HPC 用户支持智能体
items.summary: The assistant orchestrates two Model Context Protocol tools over live HPC documentation (RAG) and a Llama-3-8B model fine-tuned with QLoRA on 11,244 historical query-resolution pairs, merging their answers with every model running on-premises or on a hosted university service. On 400 held-out Purdue RCAC tickets, the fine-tuned tool is judged most correct, while the merged end-to-end system does not improve on its individual tools.

items.title: Breaking the high-degree barrier in Lehmer's problem with a human-AI discovery loop
items.title_zh: 以人机发现闭环突破 Lehmer 问题的高次障碍
items.summary: A human-AI discovery loop extends conversational prompting with a fast numerical pipeline, an exact symbolic verifier and large-scale distributed search to derive a five-parameter Generalized Boyd algorithm. Evaluated across all even degrees up to 2000, the construction eliminates degree-skipping, improves six previously published values and holds 99.6% of all best known records.

items.title: Self-Assessment Reinforcement Learning for Search-State Awareness in Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 面向检索增强大模型搜索状态感知的自评估强化学习
items.summary: SARL trains search agents to recognize what information they have obtained and what remains missing, using a dual reward that credits the corrective effect of each self-assessment while penalizing excessive reliance on it, with no additional assessment at test time. It achieves a 24.3% relative improvement over the strongest baseline, with average gains of 35.9% on multi-hop reasoning and 27.9% on deep research benchmarks.

items.title: headroomlabs-ai/headroom
items.title_zh: headroomlabs-ai/headroom — 在进入 LLM 前压缩工具输出
items.summary: Headroom compresses tool outputs, logs, files and RAG chunks before they reach an LLM; its README claims 20% fewer tokens for coding agents and 60-95% fewer tokens for JSON with the same answers. It ships as a library, proxy and MCP server.

items.title: Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6-Pro Lands on Tencent WorkBuddy and TokenHub With a 1M Context Window
items.title_zh: 小米 MiMo-V2.6-Pro 上线腾讯 WorkBuddy 与 TokenHub，支持 100 万 token 上下文
items.summary: Xiaomi's MiMo-V2.6-Pro is now available inside Tencent's WorkBuddy agent and on Tencent Cloud TokenHub as mimo-v2.6-pro, offering a 1M-token context window and OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs.

items.title: google/embeddinggemma-2
items.summary: Google's EmbeddingGemma 2 is trending on HuggingFace with 2,777 likes and 172,474 downloads since its September 14 upload, and the repo is tagged for multimodal embedding plus vision, audio and video feature extraction.

items.title: How AT&T is rethinking in-house legal work with OpenAI
items.title_zh: AT&T 如何借助 OpenAI 重塑内部法律工作
items.summary: AT&T is working with OpenAI to make legal knowledge easier to access, with its LegalEdge team rethinking intake and scaling legal judgment, according to OpenAI's customer post.

items.title: Using thousands of AI agents to uncover new leads in biological data
items.title_zh: 用数千个 AI 智能体在生物数据中发现新线索
items.summary: OpenAI, PerturbAI and Scripps Research used distributed AI agents to search data from millions of brain cells and surface promising research leads, according to OpenAI's post.
